'''Aered Argyris''' was an [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served in the [[Glare Peak civilian guard]]. He was stationed in the eastern part of [[Glare Peak]] and because of his anger at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]] was sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Rescue at Glare Peak" />
